purpose: Phase-8A persistence criteria for acquired resistance. Every acquired-resistance profile must define explicit persistence REQUIREMENTS before a state may be treated as persistent. If persistence information is unavailable it is NOT fabricated - it is labelled NOT_REPORTED and uncertainty is raised. Persistence is never implied merely because a state was previously active. Schematic thresholds only; no real durations (NOT_REPORTED).

coefficient_policy.valid_range: minimum_exposure_stages is a non-negative integer count of validated simulation stages; sustained_state_duration_stages likewise
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: thresholds gate whether an ESTABLISHED state may persist across washout; they are schematic stage counts, not real time.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No real washout time, half-life, or reversion rate is stated (all NOT_REPORTED).

rules.no_fabrication: If persistence data are unavailable, persistence = NOT_REPORTED; a MECHANISTIC_PREDICTION is used only when explicitly justified and always raises uncertainty.
rules.no_implicit_irreversibility: No state is permanent solely because it was previously active; persistence requires meeting the requirements above.
rules.washout_gate: washout_persistence_required means a state that resolves during washout is NOT persistent.
